question: The average of 8 numbers is 12. If a number Y is added to each of these 8 numbers, then the average becomes 16. What is the value of Y?
solution:
Concept:

If the average of n numbers is N and x is subtracted from each number then the new average will be N - x

And if the average of n numbers is N and x is added to each number then the new average will be N + x

Formula used:

Average = Sum of all quantities / Total number of quantities
